scenarios.title: The Broken Ventriloquist
scenarios.description: You are a ventriloquist whose dummy has started speaking on its own - and it is far more popular than you. Win back the crowd.

scenarios.title: The Reluctant Lion Tamer
scenarios.description: You are the lion tamer. Your partner is the lion. The lion has decided to unionise and is presenting its demands.

scenarios.title: Auction of Haunted Goods
scenarios.description: An auctioneer sells cursed carnival objects to bidders who each secretly want the same item for a ridiculous reason.

scenarios.title: The Slow-Motion Heist
scenarios.description: Rob the carnival ticket booth - but everything you do must be in dramatic slow motion, with your own sound effects.

scenarios.title: Operatic Complaint
scenarios.description: Return a faulty candy floss machine to the vendor. The entire complaint must be sung as an opera.

scenarios.title: Cut the Strings
scenarios.description: You are a marionette. The Puppet Master controls your movements by calling out body parts. Tell your life story while obeying.

scenarios.title: Job Interview for a Ghost
scenarios.description: A ghost interviews for the role of carnival haunter. The panel is very concerned about its lack of experience.

scenarios.title: Silent Rescue Team
scenarios.description: A rescue team must save a cat from an imaginary tree without making a single sound.

scenarios.title: Carnival Nature Documentary
scenarios.description: Narrate the mating rituals of the wild carnival-goer while your partner acts it out.

scenarios.title: Time Traveller at the Funfair
scenarios.description: You have arrived from 1890 and must buy a churro using only Victorian vocabulary.

scenarios.title: The Cursed Jury
scenarios.description: Put the Wheel of Misfortune on trial for crimes against luck. Lawyers, witnesses and a very biased judge.

scenarios.title: The Escalating Introduction
scenarios.description: Introduce yourself to the crowd. Every ten seconds the Puppet Master adds a new ridiculous condition you must obey.

performers.profile: Lifts anvils, cries at sad songs. Claims he never leaves the weights tent.
performers.name: Bruno the Strongman
performers.brief: You were actually arguing with the Ringmaster outside his caravan about unpaid wages. Never admit you left the weights tent. If pressed about mud on your boots, blame the rain.
statements: I was lifting the anvil in the weights tent all evening.
I heard the calliope stop at the second bell.
The Ringmaster owed me three weeks of wages.

performers.profile: Contortionist. Speaks only in whispers. Fiercely loyal to the Ringmaster.
performers.name: Madame Twist
performers.brief: You are telling the truth. You did see Bruno near the caravans but you are afraid of him, so only say so if asked directly about the caravans.
statements: I was rehearsing in the mirror room.
The mirror room door squeaks; anyone would have heard me.
I saw Bruno near the caravans.

performers.profile: The fire-eater. Has never been seen without her veil.
performers.name: Lady Ash
performers.brief: You were in the big top rigging a prank on the Ringmaster. Insist you were at the candy floss stand. You do not know the machine was actually working fine all night.
statements: I was at the candy floss stand the whole time.
The candy floss machine broke at the second bell.
I never go near the big top after dark.

performers.profile: Fortune teller. Claims to have foreseen the disappearance.
performers.name: Old Zelda
performers.brief: You are truthful. The out-of-town couple can be described as nervous and dressed in matching green. You did foresee trouble.
statements: I was reading cards for a couple from out of town.
My lantern was lit the entire evening.
The cards warned me about the third bell.

performers.profile: Knife thrower. Arrogant. Never misses - or so he says.
performers.name: The Great Valentino
performers.brief: You met the Ringmaster in secret to ask for top billing. Your assistant was actually off sick tonight - never admit this. Become defensive if anyone asks about your assistant.
statements: I was sharpening knives in my wagon.
My assistant was with me the whole time.
I have not spoken to the Ringmaster in days.

performers.profile: Plays the calliope. Rarely speaks, always hums.
performers.name: Silent Pete
performers.brief: You are truthful. You did see Lady Ash go into the big top but only mention it if asked about the big top or about Lady Ash.
statements: I played the calliope until the second bell.
I stopped because a key jammed.
I saw Lady Ash go into the big top.

mysteries.rules: Question each performer in character. Performers must answer every question but may refuse to touch their props. No more than two questions in a row to the same performer.

clues.text: Muddy boot prints lead from the weights tent to the Ringmaster's caravan.
The candy floss vendor swears the machine worked perfectly all night.
Valentino's assistant was seen buying cough medicine in town at 9pm.
The mirror room door has been oiled recently. It no longer squeaks.

mysteries.title: The Vanishing Ringmaster
mysteries.description: The Ringmaster disappeared from the big top between the second and third bells. Six performers were backstage. Three of them are lying about where they were. Find the liars.

performers.name: Sugar Sal
performers.brief: Truthful. The delivery did arrive at six and the sacks looked normal.
statements: I never left my stand.
The sugar delivery came at six.

performers.name: Dusty Jim
performers.brief: You opened a sack to steal some sugar for your tea. Deny it.
statements: I delivered the sugar sealed.
I did not open any sacks.

performers.name: Ink
performers.brief: You bought black dye this morning. Claim you only use red and gold.
statements: I only use red and gold paint.
I was painting the horror house all day.

performers.name: Pip
performers.brief: Truthful but vague. You think the person with black hands was tall.
statements: I saw someone with black hands near the stand.

performers.name: Doc Mortimer
performers.brief: Truthful. You tested the dye: food colouring.
statements: Nobody was seriously harmed.
The dye was harmless food colouring.

performers.name: Mister Grin
performers.brief: You want Sal's stall for your nephew. You paid Ink to dye the floss. Deny everything.
statements: I was counting money in the office.
I have no reason to sabotage Sal.

mysteries.rules: Each performer may be asked one question per investigator per minute. Accusations must be submitted through the hall terminal.

clues.text: A receipt for black food dye was found in the paint store.
One sugar sack had been opened and resealed with tape.
The office cash box was untouched all afternoon.

mysteries.title: The Poisoned Candy Floss
mysteries.description: Someone dyed the candy floss black and the whole crowd turned green. Six stall-holders handled the sugar. Three of them are lying.

fortune.label: The Fortune Teller's Curse

questions.prompt: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?
The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?

questions.successText: The calliope plays in your honour.
questions.prompt: What has keys but cannot open a single lock?

questions.failureText: No. You do not know me at all.
questions.successText: Yes... love has ruined more fortune tellers than any tower.
questions.prompt: Which tarot card does the fortune teller fear most?

questions.successText: They never leave. They have no need to walk.
questions.prompt: On which night do the carnival dead walk the pier?
How many coloured tickets travel the Carnival of the Damned?

questions.successText: Time is on your side... for now.
questions.prompt: I have hands but cannot clap, a face but cannot smile. What am I?

questions.successText: Debts are always repaid at the carnival.
questions.prompt: A raven lands on your ticket booth. What does it foretell?

questions.failureText: It has slipped away from you.
questions.successText: Keep it close. You will need it.
questions.prompt: I follow you all day but vanish at night. What am I?

questions.failureText: It does not care for that.
questions.successText: It only ever wanted to turn.
questions.prompt: What does the Wheel of Misfortune want most?

fortunes: A stranger in a velvet mask will offer you a gift. Refuse it.
Your luck turns at the stroke of the third bell.
Something you lost will find its way back - but not unchanged.
The wheel remembers every hand that spins it.
Three voices will lie to you before dawn. Count them.
Beware the stranger who never blinks.
You will win, but the prize will ask for something in return.
Under the pier, the tide keeps a ledger of names. Yours is written faintly.
Trust the colour on your ticket; it has chosen you for a reason.
The puppets dance for those who are willing to look foolish.
fortune.farewell: Go now. And do not look behind you on the pier tonight.
fortune.greeting: Sit, child. The cards have been waiting for you... answer truly, and perhaps the curse will pass you by.
